backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor serving as the backend entry point with no implemented functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting five implemented features including logo removal, header creation, gradient background, cloud animations, and hero section redesign with associated files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend source files describing their purpose, styling approach, and key functionality.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base configuration defining CSS custom properties for light and dark themes using OKLCH color space with variables for backgrounds, foregrounds, borders, and component colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with UTF-8 charset, viewport meta tag, page title, root div, and module script loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component composing CustomCursor, Header, CloudsBackground, and all page sections (Hero, Gameplay, Rewards, Shop, CTA, Footer) in a responsive layout.
frontend/src/components/CallToAction.tsx: CTA section with scroll animation, glassmorphism card containing motivational messages, Discord join button with gradient hover effects, and fresh server launch notice.
frontend/src/components/CloudsBackground: Fixed background overlay rendering three parallax layers of animated pixelated Minecraft cloud images scrolling horizontally at different speeds with varying opacity.
frontend/src/components/CustomCursor.tsx: Custom cursor component with touch device detection that renders animated cursor and trailing effect responding to hover and click states, hidden on touch devices.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with three-column grid layout displaying brand info, server IP, Discord link, copyright notice, and caffeine.ai attribution with dynamic year and hostname.
Displays the gameplay mechanics section with four animated cards explaining Lifesteal SMP features: stealing hearts on kills, losing hearts on death, PvP combat, and elimination consequences. Uses scroll animations and responsive grid layout with hover effects.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Fixed navigation header with desktop menu, mobile hamburger menu, and smooth scroll-to-section functionality. Includes Discord link button and responsive layout with glassmorphism styling.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Main hero section featuring the server title, tagline, copyable server IP address (hellcod.ddns.net:19100), and three info cards displaying game mode, version, and player capacity. Includes copy-to-clipboard functionality and Discord/play buttons.
frontend/src/components/IntroSequence.ts: Empty component file with no content.
frontend/src/components/RewardsSection.t: Displays server rewards including a premium account prize for reaching 100M in-game money, upcoming Practice PvP mode announcement, and a stats grid showing server features (24/7 uptime, etc.). Uses scroll animations and glassmorphism cards.
Shop information section showcasing premium items and crate keys available for purchase, with a Discord purchase notice. Features animated cards with icons and hover effects using glassmorphism design.
frontend/src/components/SiteLogo.tsx: Empty component file with no content.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that manages Internet Identity authentication and creates backend actors (authenticated or anonymous). Automatically invalidates and refetches dependent queries when the actor/identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React hook and provider for Internet Identity authentication on ICP, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file for future React Query hooks when backend functionality is implemented.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollAnimation.ts: React hook using IntersectionObserver to detect when elements enter viewport and trigger visibility state for scroll-based animations.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color system for blue gradient theme, scroll animation utilities, glassmorphism effects, and custom cursor disabled on touch devices.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the root component wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider for React Query and ICP authentication.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme with OKLCH color system, Minecraft-inspired cyan/purple palette, glassmorphism shadows, custom border radius, and display fonts.
project_state.json: Project metadata for HellCod MC Lifesteal Minecraft server website featuring glassmorphism design, intro sequence, server info display, and Discord/shop integration with mobile-responsive layout.
